from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,http.server,json,socketserver,threading

class H(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
 def __init__(self,*a,**kw):super().__init__(*a,directory=str(r/'site'),**kw)
 def log_message(self,*a):pass
s=socketserver.ThreadingTCPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),H);threading.Thread(target=s.serve_forever,daemon=True).start();origin='http://127.0.0.1:'+str(s.server_address[1]);observations=[];errors=[]
try:
 with sync_playwright() as pw:
  b=pw.chromium.launch(headless=True,executable_path='/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome');version=b.version
  for width,lang,theme in ((390,'en','dark'),(320,'zh','light')):
   c=b.new_context(viewport={'width':width,'height':844},device_scale_factor=1,is_mobile=True,has_touch=True,reduced_motion='reduce');c.route('**/*',lambda route:route.continue_() if urlsplit(route.request.url).hostname=='127.0.0.1' else route.abort())
   c.add_init_script("localStorage.setItem('lang',"+json.dumps(lang)+");localStorage.setItem('theme',"+json.dumps(theme)+");")
   page=c.new_page();page.on('pageerror',lambda e:errors.append(str(e)));page.goto(origin+'/confluence_screener.html',wait_until='load')
   filename='locked-'+str(width)+'-'+lang+'.png';page.locator('.locked').first.screenshot(path=str(out/filename))
   obs=page.locator('.locked').evaluate_all("""nodes=>nodes.map(n=>({text:n.innerText,explanation:n.querySelector('.sub').innerText,href:n.querySelector('a').getAttribute('href'),label:n.querySelector('a').innerText,overflow:n.scrollWidth>n.clientWidth+1,width:n.getBoundingClientRect().width,buttonHeight:n.querySelector('a').getBoundingClientRect().height}))""")
   data=(out/filename).read_bytes();observations.append({'width':width,'lang':lang,'theme':theme,'locked_cards':obs,'document_overflow':page.evaluate('document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth+1'),'capture':{'file':filename,'bytes':len(data),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'blob':hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(data)).encode()+b'\0'+data).hexdigest()}});c.close()
  b.close()
finally:s.shutdown();s.server_close()
report={'schema':'confluence_copy_visual_inspection.v1','browser':version,'contexts':2,'observations':observations,'page_errors':errors,'scope':'Visual inspection of the two changed actual saved-page locked explanations. No new functional browser-test claim, live entitlement, external navigation or deployment.'}
(out/'inspection.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False))
